articles.description: Irish residents of Saggart warn Oxfordshire and Suffolk villages about violence and crime risks after the Citywest Hotel migrant center caused local riots and safety concerns.

articles.title: Our hell after migrants took over our town - now it's coming to your home: English villages face hundreds of asylum seekers being housed nearby. Irish families left living in terror amid riots and sexual assault fears share their dire warning
